title: The Mystery of Bloodline
next_chapter_hook: Just as Chen Ji was immersed in the shock of the bloodline truth, Ling Yuan's voice suddenly rang out in his mind: 'You've finally discovered it, we are family.'

text.content: Ye Qing's words were like a thunderclap, exploding in Chen Ji's mind—with a blood relationship with me? That mysterious commander who commanded the Demonic Path army to sweep across three provinces actually has a blood connection to atrash杂役 of the Tianqing Sect? His fingertips trembled slightly, but his face remained as unruffled as ever, as if he were merely listening to an insignificant rumor.

dialogue.content: "I know this sounds absurd," Ye Qing's voice was extremely low, her beautiful eyes flickering with complexity, "but the ancient texts I saw in the Holy Sect's Forbidden Grounds cannot be wrong. That commander's cultivation technique traces have a seventy percent similarity to the Tianqing Sect's sect-protecting secret classic—and only the old sect master's lineage can cultivate the Tianqing Sect's techniques."

text.content: Seventy percent similarity. Chen Ji silently repeated these four words in his heart, a flash of keen light passing through the depths of his eyes. He knew better than anyone that the Tianqing Sect's sect-protecting secret classic, the 'Tianxuan Art,' had been passed down exclusively to the sect master's lineage for three hundred years, never leaked. If the Demonic Path commander truly mastered this technique... then the only explanation was that this person also came from the sect master's lineage.

dialogue.content: "What else did you see in the Holy Sect's Forbidden Grounds, Ye Qing?" Chen Ji's voice was terrifyingly calm, but his fingers were secretly forming seals within his sleeve, establishing a connection with the third page of the Tianji Record. "Are there more specific records about that commander's background?"

"There are." A chill flickered through Ye Qing's eyes. "That commander originally had the surname Chen. Fifteen years ago, all traces of him were erased from the sect's history. And in the Tianqing Sect's records, there just so happens to be a disciple named Chen who disappeared fifteen years ago—reportedly the old sect master's closed-door disciple."

text.content: Chen Ji's breath caught slightly. Fifteen years ago was exactly the year he was tested and found to have the Tianxuan spiritual root yet couldn't cultivate. It was also that same year that his father sent him to the Tianqing Sect as a servant disciple, never to appear again. Now that he thought about it, too many things had happened that year—too many, as if an invisible hand were manipulating everything behind the scenes.

The third page of the Tianji Record—Causal Traceback. He injected a thread of Heavenly Fate Value into that page of yellowed paper, and black patterns writhed like living things across its surface, finally condensing into a complex formation array. A cold sensation transmitted from his fingertips, and Chen Ji felt his consciousness being drawn away by an invisible force, slowly falling into a chaotic space.

Within the chaos, countless points of light sparkled like stars, each point a node on a bloodline thread. Following his instincts, Chen Ji focused his consciousness on the connection between himself and Ling Yuan—a faint red thread emerged in the void, extending toward the endless past.

He traced back along the thread. Light points brushed past him one by one, as if time had lost all meaning—ten years, twenty years, fifty years, a hundred years... Finally, at the source of this bloodline thread, he saw a mountain peak piercing the clouds, and on its summit stood a figure in white robes as pure as snow.

dialogue.content: This..." Chen Ji's eyes widened. That figure's features were almost identical to the portrait of Chen Xuan recorded on the Tianji Record Fragment—sword-like brows and star-like eyes, transcendent bearing, a faint, composed smile always playing at the corner of the lips, as if all things in the world were within his calculations.

text.content: The first generation master of the Tianji Record—Chen Xuan. He was not only the creator of the Tianji Record but also the ancestor of the Chen family! All bloodline threads radiated outward from him, and both himself and Ling Yuan were merely two branches sprouting from this towering tree.

choice.prompt: The truth was so shocking that Chen Ji had to decide how to face this discovery. His bloodline's origin was actually connected to the first generation master of the Tianji Record, and Ling Yuan was of the same clan as him—how would this fact change his plans?

choices.text: Immediately awaken himself and return to the room to destroy the evidence
choices.description: Ye Qing knows too much, the secret must not be leaked. While the Tianji Record's tracing ability's residual energy hasn't yet dissipated, strike first.
choices.visible_cost: Consume 5 points of Heavenly Fate Value
choices.visible_reward: Keep the bloodline secret and control the initiative
choices.risk_hint: Ye Qing may sense your killing intent
choices.process_label: 你在心中sneered：知道得太多的人，往往活不长。

text.content: Chen Ji suddenly opened his eyes, the backlash from the causal traceback causing his temples to throb with pain. He saw Ye Qing still standing in place, waiting for his answer. A flash of killing intent flickered in his eyes—he knew this woman far too much. But reconsidering, Ye Qing's grudge against the Holy Sect ran equally deep. Perhaps keeping her alive was more valuable than killing her.

choices.text: Continue deeper into the traceback to see the specific relationship between Ling Yuan and himself
choices.description: Just knowing the common ancestor isn't enough—he needs more specific information. Does Ling Yuan know about this? Are there other members of the Chen family?
choices.visible_cost: Consume another 5 points of Heavenly Fate Value
choices.visible_reward: Obtain more detailed intelligence about Ling Yuan's background
choices.risk_hint: Insufficient Heavenly Fate Value may trigger Tianji Record backlash

text.content: Chen Ji endured the weakness from the loss of Heavenly Fate Value, once again probing his consciousness into that chaotic space. Following the bloodline thread connected to Ling Yuan, he pushed deeper, and finally at another node, he saw Ling Yuan's shadow—a spirited young man, kneeling before Chen Xuan, receiving his legacy.

choices.text: Casually inquire Ye Qing for more details
choices.description: Pretend to know nothing and let Ye Qing continue talking. Sometimes, knowing how much information the other party holds is more important than rushing to act.
choices.visible_reward: Extract all intelligence Ye Qing possesses
choices.risk_hint: Ye Qing may see through your disguise

text.content: Chen Ji put away the Tianji Record and restored that harmless smile to his face. "Interesting," he said softly, as if discussing someone else's family affairs, "but what does any of this have to do with me? I'm just a servant disciple after all."

He saw more. Ling Yuan was not only Chen Xuan's inheritor but also his direct disciple—Chen Xuan discovered Ling Yuan's exceptional spiritual roots and took him in as an adopted son, teaching him the Tianxuan Art and portions of the Tianji Record's essentials. However, on the very night Ling Yuan was about to inherit the Tianji Record, Chen Xuan suddenly died violently, and the Tianji Record disappeared without a trace.

Chen Xuan's bloodline did not end. Before his fall, he sealed a strand of his divine soul and essence blood into the Tianji Record, awaiting an inheritor with destiny. And that destined person was precisely Chen Ji's father—a disciple cast aside by the sect, a forgotten collateral descendant of the Chen family.

So, the Tianji Record selected father's direct bloodline, not Ling Yuan." Chen Ji murmured to himself, and finally a hint of understanding appeared in his eyes. Ling Yuan hated him, not because he stole the sect master's position, but because the Tianji Record skipped a generation and directly chose the second generation. Ling Yuan was completely abandoned by his own 'father.'

choice.prompt: Traceback complete. Chen Ji finally understood the true reason for Ling Yuan's targeting him. But now he faced a crucial decision: how to use this intelligence?

choices.text: Use the intelligence as leverage and temporarily bide his time
choices.description: Having cards in hand, one need not be anxious. This isn't the time to reveal everything. Better to continue feigning ignorance and wait for a better opportunity.
choices.visible_reward: Maintain strategic advantage, avoid startling the prey

text.content: Chen Ji slowly opened his eyes. The ability of the Tianji Record's third page had been exhausted, but the agitation deep in his bloodline remained unsettled. He drew a deep breath, pressing all the shock and contemplation deep in his heart. He had seen through Ling Yuan's cards, but the chess game was far from its conclusion.

choices.text: Deliberately reveal flaws in front of Ling Yuan to draw out the enemy
choices.description: Since knowing Ling Yuan's obsession, why not actively create an opportunity, letting him think there's an opening? The hunter often appears as prey.
choices.visible_reward: Draw out Ling Yuan's true hidden cards
choices.risk_hint: May fall into Ling Yuan's trap

text.content: A faint, unnoticeable smile curled at the corner of his lips. Chen Ji suddenly turned and walked toward the direction of the Tianqing Sect Main Peak. He knew that with Ling Yuan's personality, he would never miss any opportunity to test him. And he needed exactly this opportunity to confirm certain things.

"Wait." Ye Qing suddenly called out to him, a trace of inquiry in her beautiful eyes. "You just used the Tianji Record's ability?" She sensed that familiar fluctuation of energy, identical to descriptions of the Tianji Record in Holy Sect records. "Your Tianji Record has been repaired to the third page?"

dialogue.content: Chen Ji's footsteps paused, but he didn't turn around. "That's none of your business." His voice was cold, yet carried an unquestionable rejection. "The cooperation between us doesn't include probing each other's trump cards. You only need to know that I won't let the Holy Sect have it easy, and that's enough."

text.content: Ye Qing didn't press further. She watched Chen Ji's departing figure, a complex expression flickering in her eyes. This man's thoughts were as deep as an ancient well. Every time you thought you saw through him, you'd only glimpsed the blue sky at the well's opening. But somehow, she didn't feel afraid; instead, there was an odd sense of security.

The night wind brushed across Tianqing Peak as Chen Ji walked alone on the Mountain Path. His mood had settled, his face returning to that unruffled appearance, as if the bloodline traceback had merely been an insignificant dream. But only he knew that the seed had already taken root in his heart.

"Ling Yuan, do you think I'm your enemy?" Chen Ji coldly thought in his heart. "No, you and I are merely two pieces on the same chessboard. The true chess player is that existence that selected us both—Chen Xuan, or more precisely, the will of the Tianji Record itself."

choice.prompt: Chen Ji faced one final decision: what should he do next? The blood relationship between Ling Yuan and himself had been confirmed, but how should this card be played?

choices.text: Go find Mo Xiansheng to inquire about the complete truth of Chen Xuan and the Tianji Record
choices.description: Mo Xiansheng is Chen Xuan's left-behind guardian, perhaps knowing more of the inside story. Moreover, why the Tianji Record skipped Ling Yuan and chose his father—this question must be answered.
choices.visible_cost: May consume Heavenly Fate Value or trigger Mo Xiansheng's limitations
choices.visible_reward: Obtain more intelligence about the Tianji Record's operational mechanism
choices.risk_hint: Mo Xiansheng may be hiding something

text.content: Chen Ji found a secluded spot and delved his consciousness into the first page of the Tianji Record. Mo Xiansheng's figure slowly manifested in the void, those deep eyes seeming to hide countless secrets. "You've come," the old man said indifferently. "You wish to ask about Chen Xuan, I presume?"

choices.text: Return to the Servants' Quarters and investigate the Chen family history starting from the clan genealogy
choices.description: Among father's left-behind belongings, there might be records about the Chen family. If physical evidence can be found, it can verify whether the Tianji Record's traceback results are accurate.
choices.visible_cost: Will require time to search through
choices.visible_reward: May discover key clues left by father
choices.risk_hint: May attract the attention of those with ulterior motives

text.content: Chen Ji returned to the small hut in the Servants' Quarters and retrieved a dusty wooden box from the hidden compartment under the bed. This was the only relic left by his father; he had never opened it. At this moment, his fingers trembled slightly as he slowly lifted the lid.

choices.text: Go directly to Ling Yuan and confront him about this blood relationship
choices.description: Since already knowing the truth, why not directly reveal the cards? He wanted to see what reaction Ling Yuan would have upon learning that he also knew the truth.
choices.visible_cost: Expose the fact that one possesses the Tianji Record's traceback ability
choices.risk_hint: May fall right into Ling Yuan's scheme

text.content: Chen Ji's footsteps suddenly stopped. He turned and walked toward the direction of the Main Peak, his eyes gleaming. Since Ling Yuan liked to test, let him test to his heart's content. He wanted to see where this game would go when both sides knew each other's cards.

However, the instant he took his first step, an ancient yet majestic voice suddenly rang in his mind, like thunder piercing the ear: "You've finally discovered it, we are family." It was Ling Yuan's voice, carrying a hint of hard-to-detect triumph and madness. Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply—Ling Yuan could actually transmit his voice directly into Chen Ji's Mental Sea? What did this mean? Had his Tianji Record's aura already been locked onto by Ling Yuan?
